posts.title: Bash Has a Call Stack (And It's Glorious)
posts.description: Sometimes Bash quietly hides features that make you stop, blink, and say: “Wait… that’s been there the whole time?! ” This post is about one of those features: Bash knows which function you’re in — and even keeps a call stack .
